task: Mahiro White Cat Samurai lane-C local scale repair
method: split selected C into six 128x128 frames, trim alpha content, resize each content crop to a shared 113px height, place all frames on a fixed 128x128 canvas with bottom baseline at y=122, then reassemble
intent: reduce perceived per-frame scale/zoom drift while preserving C identity and walk poses
qa_note: Height and baseline are now locked across frames. Width still varies by pose, especially frame 6, but that reads more like silhouette/stride variation than camera zoom. No runtime assets edited.
defringe: Applied ImageMagick fuzz 10% transparent #ff00ff pass after height/baseline lock; QA preview did not show loss of sakura/ear details.
